s: Shello leyalled habbehema beshabbat ubo g' seipim: en meyalledin et habbehema, velo apillu mesaadin, dehaynu leechoz bavvalad shello yippol laaretz. Veken shear tzorke havvalad shehittiru litroach bahem beyom tob kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqk"g — asur litroach bahem beshabbat:

En meparkesin libhema gilde makka, velo sakin makkatah beshemen, sheasur litroach bishbil behema. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bigmar makka, sheeno oseh lah ella letaanug bealma, abal keshello nitrappea hammakka sheyyesh lah tzaar mimmenna — muttar litroach bishbilah:

Im okla karshinin harbeh umitztaeret — yakol laharitzah bechatzer kede shettityaggea vetitrappeh, veap al pi shezzehu repua lah, veal kol repua gazeru mishshum shechiqat sammanim, mikkol maqom birpuat behema lo gazeru, mippene sheen adam bahul kol kak al repuat behemto sheyyabo lishchoq sammanim. Veken im achaza dam — yakol lehaamidah bemayim kede shettitztannen. Veim hu sapeq sheim lo yaqqizu lah dam tamut — muttar lomar lenokri lehaqqiz lah, shemmittok sheadam bahul al mitat behemto im lo nattir lo al yede nokri — yabo lehaqqiz beatzmo:
